item.title: 7th Kaziranga Waterbird Count Records 105,540 Birds; Rare Smew Makes First-Ever Appearance
item.description: GUWAHATI: Kaziranga National Park, the UNESCO World Heritage Site located in Assam, has once again reaffirmed its ecological significance globally with the release of the 7th Kaziranga Waterbird Count 2026 report. The census recorded an impressive 105,540 individual waterbirds representing 107 species, marking one of the highest tallies since the initiative began. item.title: Assam Doctor Found Dead in Odisha’s Cuttack District, Fall from Balcony Suspected Cause
item.description: GUWAHATI: A 28-year-old doctor from Morigaon in Assam was found dead at Olatpur in Odisha’s Cuttack district on the morning of Thursday, February 26. It is suspected that Dr Ruhan Kakati fell to his death from the balcony of his second-floor accommodation at Kavita Complex near SVNIRTAR Hospital. He was engaged in private physiotherapy practice. item.title: APDCL Services to Remain Shut from Feb 28 Night to March 2 Morning
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Assam Power Distribution Company Limited (APDCL) will shut down its services from 9 PM on February 28 to 9 AM on March 2 due to system upgrade activities. The services, both online and offline, will include electricity bill payment and recharge facilities, a notification said.
